name: maestro-driven-development
description: Platform-aware development workflow skills with Maestro-first driven development.

interface.shortDescription: Mandatory MDD workflow: clarify requirements, write a Maestro test plan, then execute RED/GREEN with Maestro.
interface.longDescription: A portable skill bundle for Maestro-supported targets. When a user asks to build, fix, test, or implement with Maestro Driven Development/MDD, the default route is mandatory: clarify requirements first, write a Maestro test plan inside the implementation plan, then execute task-by-task with Maestro-only RED-GREEN-REFACTOR evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use MDD to clarify requirements before planning or coding.
Write a Maestro test plan before implementation.
Execute the approved MDD plan with Maestro RED/GREEN evidence.
